points.quote: If you are considering using GenAI tools as part of an assessment, you should check whether this is permitted, in line with the University's Academic Integrity Statement.
points.anchor: Academic Integrity in the Context of GenAI
points.gist: Students should check whether GenAI is permitted in an assessment, in line with the Academic Integrity Statement.

points.quote: If you are unsure about using AI tools for your work, please talk to your lecturer or tutor to check their expectations.
points.anchor: Additional Academic Integrity Information and Support
points.gist: Students unsure about AI use should talk to their lecturer or tutor about expectations.

points.quote: This resource forms part of the training to support you to satisfactorily complete the Academic Integrity Initiative Test.
points.anchor: Academic Integrity in the Context of GenAI
points.gist: The academic integrity GenAI guide is part of the training for the Academic Integrity Initiative Test.

points.quote: Firstly, Introduction to Microsoft Copilot introduces you to Microsoft Copilot, what it can do and strategies for using it effectively and ethically.
points.gist: An Introduction to Microsoft Copilot resource covers what Copilot can do and how to use it effectively and ethically.

points.quote: Secondly, the Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Module is designed to equip you with essential GenAI skills tailored for academic contexts
points.gist: A GenAI Module is designed to give students essential GenAI skills for academic contexts.

points.quote: The Skills Centre has produced a video guide setting out nine key points and questions to consider helping you use AI tools confidently and responsibly in your work.
points.gist: The Skills Centre has a video guide with nine key points and questions on using AI tools responsibly.

points.quote: You can find extensive guidance on referencing in The Library’s Referencing Guide, including specific content on Academic Integrity, Plagiarism and AI.
points.anchor: Additional Academic Integrity Information and Support
points.gist: The Library's Referencing Guide includes content on academic integrity, plagiarism and AI.
